title: UK Announces Ban on Goods From Israeli Settlements
title_cn: 英国宣布禁止来自以色列定居点的货物
summary: Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband, speaking in the House of Commons, said the UK will ban the import of goods from illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied territories through a new sanctions regime. “The British government agrees that there is ethnic cleansing of Palestinians in areas of the West Bank,” Miliband told lawmakers. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Turkey Signs Deal With Russia to Boost Fertilizer Imports
title_cn: 土耳其与俄罗斯签署协议以增加化肥进口
summary: Turkey signed a memorandum of understanding with Russia on Tuesday to import larger volumes of nitrogen fertilizer and overcome difficulties in sourcing urea from Persian Gulf producers, according to the Agriculture Ministry.

title: Canada's Carney Takes Calculated Risk in US Trade War
title_cn: 加拿大总理卡尼在美国贸易战中承担了经过计算的风险
summary: Canada imposed tariffs of up to 50% on hundreds or products from the US as Prime Minister Mark Carney bets that standing up to President Donald Trump will help with Ottawa's negotiating position. It's not clear how the US will respond to this move yet. Bloomberg's Derek Decloet reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bolsonaro Moves Past Lula as Court Crisis Energizes Right
title_cn: 法庭危机激发右翼力量 博尔索纳罗超越卢拉
summary: Flávio Bolsonaro pulled ahead of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in a new poll as the right-wing senator seizes on turmoil at Brazil’s Supreme Court to rally conservative voters.

title: Who’s Afraid of the DSA? Democrats Confront a Growing Insurgent Wing
title_cn: 谁害怕 DSA？民主党面临日益壮大的叛乱势力
summary: Socialists and progressives enjoyed a summer of success in the primaries, but lasting change to the Democratic Party requires winning wary moderates. Kate Sullivan explains what's at stake  (Source: Bloomberg)
